mentions.name: MyTraL
mentions.description: A personal training log that consolidates years of athletic history into one sovereign system. It digitizes paper handwritten logs and visual models, handles athletic metrics with trademarked names and multidimensional models, and builds AI coach agents with distinct characters (e.g., Al Pacino in Any Given Sunday, a teenage coach) that use ICL model-based predictions. It also ingests photos, recordings, and shared data, and added support for the Strava & LeCol everesting challenge.
mentions.problem: Years of training logs are scattered across paper handwritten logs and visual models, and athletic metrics come with confusing trademarked names and multidimensional models that are hard to consolidate.
mentions.audience: Sovereign athletes - individuals managing their own training data and history
